notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two hinged leaves of each double-door closet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts manipulated in succession; their individual closing midpoints are less certain because the closing actions occur close together and are partly obscured.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The visible interactions comprise two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
